For the 2002–03 season, the French Division 1 was renamed as '''Ligue 1''' and was expanded to contain 20 clubs, which played 38 matches against each other, rather than the 34 matches in previous seasons. [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] won the '''2002–03 Ligue 1 season''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 68 points.
